A limited liability company that is classified as a partnership pursuant to the internal revenue code shall be treated as a partnership for purposes of chapter 30, title 63 , Idaho Code.

notes:
Idaho has a statute literally captioned "Franchise tax" - I.C. § 63-3025A - and it fails the inclusion test for this namespace's reader because of its subjects, not its label: it is imposed "upon any corporation, other than an S corporation, for the privilege of exercising its corporate franchise within the state", measured by income, with a $20 minimum. A default LLC is not a corporation: § 63-3006A classifies an LLC under the Internal Revenue Code and treats a partnership-classified LLC as a partnership for the whole income-tax chapter. Section 63-3079's "Franchise tax not repealed" savings clause therefore preserves corporate and insurance-premium franchise taxes, not a levy on a default LLC. The Tax Commission's own tax-type index - individual income, business income, sales and use, fuels, and the rest - likewise lists no franchise tax for the LLC.
The $10 Permanent Building Fund tax (I.C. § 63-3082) is the closest thing to an annual entity charge and it is excluded for a measured reason: partnerships pay it only "for each partner for whom it pays the Idaho income tax due", so a default LLC whose members file their own returns owes nothing. It is a per-member surcharge on entity-paid income tax, not a levy on being registered.
stateIncomeTax: members owe Idaho income tax on pass-through income at the flat 2025 rate of 5.3 per cent. The state has a pass-through entity tax election - I.C. § 63-3026B (added 2021, amended 2026) - under which an electing partnership or S corporation (including a partnership-taxed LLC) pays the corporate income-tax rate on its Idaho-source affected-business-entity income, and members receive credits for their share. The section was amended in the 2026 session (2026, ch. 81), and the text read here is the amended text.
collectedWithAnnualReport is null by construction: with no franchise-type levy on a default LLC there is no overlap with root states.json's annual_report_fee (0 for Idaho).
